kind: frozen v4 ES actual database process CPU matched throughput, target0.10 core

experiment.storage: one new owned standard Docker local disk volume, distinct from prior tmpfs experiments

plan.scope: matched measured database process CPU; compare direct and frozen-v4 Weir successful throughput, not quota-only and not CPU-normalized estimates

formal.rate: each path calibrated independently and then locked; no changes inside measurement
formal.paired_recovery: at most two recalibration rounds with complete pair replacements; every unmatched pair retained and identified

calibration.rate_bound_note: use stricter bound if helper mutation reservation includes seed; legal full formal trial must fit 300000 planned mutations

qualification: DB process CPU measured over complete fixed formal measurement
both paths within target ±5% and pair CPU relative-to-mean difference ≤5% for a matched pair
API/UNKNOWN/drop/scheduler lag/client CPU/Weir CPU are preserved; sustained frontend or generator bottleneck is separately reported
no interpolated throughput or CPU-normalized estimates substituted for matched live values
same write semantics and corpus; reset only owned fixture collection/index before each trial; full APPLIED content audit
observation: authoritative DB PID/startticks/container/restarts and actual quota/memory
process and cgroup CPU separately; RSS/cache/IO/CFS/GC are not implied equal by CPU matching
20s warm and 60s measure separate; keep every 10s window
owned fixture cleanup and independent inventory/NotFound/port-forward proof
limits: targets initially proposed .10/.18 then .15; before any formal loads target unified to .10 because frozen helper bounds rate6400/workers64/planned mutations300000
only one CPU target; not the maximum throughput curve
cannot establish identical memory or IO load; successful RPS is conditional on workload and tested deployment profile

storage.mongodb: ordinary owned emptyDir4Gi, WT256Mi and oplog64Mi
storage.elasticsearch: fresh owned labelled ordinary disk volume for complete new cohort; reset only owned index before each trial
storage.reason: longer pure-write full trials would count tmpfs data pages against DB1536Mi and confound CPU matching through RAM/GC; do not pool this cohort with earlier tmpfs measurements
storage.cleanup: owner identity and label verified, only new owned volume removed; foreign containers/volumes preserved

cpu_sampling.scope: all available authoritative DB process samples within full fixed formal nominal60s measurement; never select individual10s buckets
cpu_sampling.cpu_formula: (last CPU ticks - first CPU ticks)/CLK_TCK/(last actual sample time - first actual sample time)
cpu_sampling.counter_span_note: 1Hz MongoDB or existing ES subsecond sampler normally covers about59s; report actual span/coverage. Throughput still successful operations divided by fixed60s. No extra remote boundary commands.

protocol_amendment.authority: root samefixture measured observer baseline disproved diagnostic floor; preserve original2Hz instrumentation
protocol_amendment.mixed: One additional60s commonwarm220/s splitD/W30s each, then recalibrationround1 andround2 only, Dinitial120/Winitial3000; oldround0 failure andr008 interrupted preserved; no thirdrecalibrationround
protocol_amendment.pure: Original independent protocol commonwarm>=60s and initialround0 plus atmost2recalibrationrounds

instrumentation_revision.reason: Observer-only baseline disproved large Java diagnostic floor; preserve original every-loop fullESstats. Same-owner coordinator handoff only, no instrument cadence change.

interrupted_trials.reason: Coordinator paused to investigate instrumentation floor; full client output was not captured before handoff. No CPU/health/audit qualification claimed. DB process unchanged.

observer_only_baseline.sampler_note: Same original observer sequence resources then fullESstats then0.5s wait. Process CPU is measured without baseline subtraction.

calibrations.reason: Original six calibration trials exhausted target gate; preserved before same-process observer-baseline diagnosis.

instrument_error.reason: Copied comparison module REPO resolved to scratch, git rev-parse failed; new runner now binds measurement module REPO to actual workspace

Old sampler resource read timing used entry time; request/read brackets required by protocol. SIGTERM after completed prewarm and calibration, partial current calibration excluded. No formal trial ran.
Frozen helper max-rate6400 timing-only qualification failed; no database workload or calibration/formal measurement ran. Retained and not included in throughput result.

cpu_timing_limit: /proc counter read lies in saved request/read bracket. CPU uses read-complete monotonic span; conservatively require full brackets inside complete fixed measurement, first-read/last-request boundary gaps<=2s and last-request minus first-read>=57s. Preserve bracket uncertainty; successful RPS denominator fixed60s. No10s CPU selection or interpolation.
health_limit: CPU matched and health qualified are distinct; only joint qualification used as stable-capacity evidence. Formal health: APIUNKNOWN/OOM0, client_drop<=0.1%, clientCPU<1.8, WeirCPU<3.6, clientlagp99<=100ms, fewer than2 high-drop10s windows(each drop/planned>0.1%). Matching CPU does not match IO/RSS or isolate pool size.

failed_trials.reason_hypothesis: Frozen helper PID1 idle mode exits after45minutes, stopping concurrent exec trial. Same fixture started around03:34UTC, failure04:19UTC after full trial but before audit. Observed timing/source match; container exitstate was not saved before automatic finally cleanup, so precise exitcause not independently proved.
